title: Service Contracts: countersigning an offer in time, and when an offer lapses
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product governs the countersignature of a contract offer and the lapse of an offer that is not countersigned in time. It applies to every offer while the contract is pending signature.

## Formal clauses
1. Only the customer can countersign its contract.
2. The offer must be countersigned no later than the tier's countersignature window, in calendar days, after the offer was issued.
3. The window ends on the offer issue date plus the tier's window days, counted on calendar dates, and a countersignature on that last day is in time.
4. An offer not countersigned in time lapses and is terminated by the system, and a new offer must be issued.
5. Rates apply to cargo received from the effective date, never to cargo received before it, whatever the signing date.

## Effect on the contract
- Countersignature by the customer moves the contract from pending signature to active, and the contract takes effect from its effective date.
- A lapse moves the offer from pending signature to terminated; this is done by the system at the end of the countersignature window.

## The time test at a glance
| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event that starts the clock | the issue of the offer |
| Record relied on | the offer issue date on the line's record of that contract |
| Length | the tier's countersignature window, in calendar days |
| Last day | the issue date plus the window days, counted on calendar dates |
| Comparison | the countersignature date must be no later than the last day |
| Countersignature on the last day | in time |
| Not countersigned in time | the offer lapses, is terminated by the system, and a new offer must be issued |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical 10-day window, for illustration only)
An offer is issued on 2026-03-10, so the last day of a 10-day window is 2026-03-20.
- Countersigned on 2026-03-12: in time.
- Countersigned on 2026-03-20, the last day: in time.
- Not countersigned by 2026-03-20: the offer lapses; a countersignature offered on 2026-03-21 cannot revive it, and a new offer must be issued.

## Points of judgement
**Can the line countersign on the customer's behalf?** No. Only the customer can countersign its contract.

**The customer countersigned early. Do the rates start on the signing date?** No. The rates apply to cargo received from the effective date; with a hypothetical effective date of 2026-04-01 and a signature on 2026-03-25, cargo received on 2026-03-28 is not carried at the contract rates, while cargo received on 2026-04-02 is.
